licence: Derived from UKRI Gateway to Research under the Open Government Licence v3.0. OpenAlex data is CC0. Scopus and Web of Science citation counts are excluded.

coverage_caveats.partners: Partner organisations are reported to GtR by some funders and not others. EPSRC, BBSRC, NERC, AHRC and ESRC name no partners at all, so the consortium network shows collaborative R&D consortia (chiefly Innovate UK and ISCF) and is not a complete map of UK CE collaboration.
coverage_caveats.pi: A named principal investigator is present for 385 of 1,640 projects (23.5%) and is recorded in surname-plus-initial form, which cannot reliably distinguish individuals.
coverage_caveats.country: Lead organisation country resolves for about half of projects because ROR does not cover small UK companies.
coverage_caveats.citations: Citation counts shown are OpenAlex only and are missing for many publications.
